reuse.why: Uses getMonthWideCategories (wrapped in a new getMonthWideBudgetCategories that folds in the income/tracking rule), getSheetValue, the sum-amount sheet cells, batchMessages and the mutator(undoable) registration.

duplication.why: Removes the repeated income/tracking check from setZero and the N-month average by moving it into the shared selection; only the small expense/income sign flip is re-expressed inline rather than shared with setNMonthAvg.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the new action, with a small related refactor of setZero/setMonthWideNMonthAvg to share the category rule; copyPreviousMonth's own filter is left untouched.

maintainability.why: Category selection is now one function used by every month-wide action that selects categories, so the new action cannot drift from the others.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getMonthWideCategories via the new getMonthWideBudgetCategories wrapper.

disguised_duplication.where: Only the one-line sign flip (cat.is_income === 1 ? sum : 0 - sum) mirrors setNMonthAvg's avg *= -1; it is not disguised logic of any size.
